text:
sara: Quick sync — we need to lock calendar windows for a joint H200 + Gaudi launch cadence and schedule the SI dry-run. Partners are asking for SKU freeze ~2 weeks before their cutover. @nate can you confirm vendor cutover dates? :calendar:

nate: Pinging HS at VendorX now. Tentative slots they gave: H200 pilot week of May 18-22, Gaudi pilot week of Jun 1-5. They warned of a possible firmware backlog that could slip Gaudi by ~1 week. Will update asap. :phone:

jin: Thanks — from an infra side we'll need final driver/kernel builds 3 business days before pilot. Also need to decide CUDA vs ROCm image tags for marketplace tests.

jin: Plan to run a staging dry-run the week before — quick command I’ll use for the canary deploy:```kubectl apply -f canary-deploy.yaml --dry-run=client && ./run-smoketests.sh --target=canary```

marco: FYI, SI partners asked for full access to our test harnesses (read-only) + access tokens. I flagged networking/power constraints in their lab — they may request a reduced batch size. Risk: Gaudi 2nd-gen NIC shows intermittent drops in our lab v3 image.

ellie: Product note — marketplace requires final SKU names and short descriptions 10 business days before listing. Proposed SKUs: `redwood.h200.large`, `redwood.gaudi.medium-bf16`. I'll draft the copy and send for legal review.

nate: VendorX contact (HS) confirmed H200 fixed; Gaudi might slip to Jun 8-12 if firmware hits. They asked if we can run a contingency canary against B200 tier as fallback.

jin: We should also pin kernel versions in the image tag to avoid last-minute drift. Suggest tags like `redwood/h200:linux5.15-cuda12` and `redwood/gaudi:rocm5.2-bf16`.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "HW Vendor Launch Dry-run" for 2026-05-14 10:00-11:00 and invited: sara, jin, marco, ellie, nate. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 :spiral_calendar:

marco: SI checklist (quick):
- confirm network QoS and power profile
- provide test datasets (2TB) and access method
- validate driver images on SI lab (3 runs)
- SI runbook + oncall contact

ellie: Also confirm embargo / comms window with marketing. We need a 48-hour preannounce freeze if press slots involved.

sara: Action items: 
- nate: lock vendor dates + confirm fallback (H200 -> B200) by EOD Tue
- jin: prep canary deploy script + image tags, run staging dry-run week before pilot
- marco: share SI access template and list of test datasets by Fri
- ellie: marketplace SKU names + copy by next Wed; confirm legal review timeline
- deploy-bot / ops: event on 2026-05-14 stands, add runbook link to invite

sara: If anyone sees a hard blocker (network/power/firmware) call it out here now. Otherwise we'll treat the tentative vendor dates as the working plan and proceed with canary prep. :thumbsup:
